answer_1.quote: Our approach is based on the observation that while Large Language Models (LLMs) may not be effective classifiers... we adopt a generate-then-predict approach for forecasting conversation derailments. We first fine-tune an LLM on modeling online conversations. We then sample multiple conversation continuations from this fine-tuned LLM...

answer_2.quote: We calculate the BLEU score between different continuations given the same conversation history to evaluate the diversity of generated conversation continuations.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation study to assess the quality of the social orientation labels generated by GPT-4o. We recruited 6 graduate and undergraduate research assistants...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed correctness of GPT-4o-generated social orientation labels on a turn-by-turn basis using categories: Agree, Somewhat Agree, Disagree, Not Applicable.
